scope: Actual pinned C/ARM first-task/SVC/PendSV routines and actual task selector; SVC0/BX-LR boundaries, software FP/core frames, masks, same/other task, ready-list rotation, stack canary selection and assertions
limitations: PendSV selection is a function fixture in port-isolation cases; kernel selection is tested separately without interception except a bounded overflow hook. Exception-return instructions/SVC0 are not executed here. No physical exception scheduling or complete vector/image identity proof.
